indexed_original_records.interface: frames[raw].record.header_offset and payload_length permit direct seek to only selected records; check TFRecord CRC before parsing. JPEG and LiDAR range images need not be decoded to inventory image availability, camera calibration, pose or compressed sensor presence.

fields.w2l: Despite its short name, maps anchor-local metres to FRONT camera coordinates
fields.cloud: Nearest real LiDAR return per FRONT pixel after FOV projection; not a dense depth map
fields.ground: Ground flag for each cached cloud return
fields.ground_local: All measured ground points for the frame before FRONT visibility thinning
fields.guard: Conservative union of FRONT annotation rectangles dilated 2px and original selected masks where present
fields.box_center/box_half/box_axes: All valid annotated 3D boxes in anchor-local coordinates

cached_FRONT_records.pixel_projection: camera_xyz = local_xyz @ w2l[:3,:3].T + w2l[:3,3]; uv = (camera_xyz @ K.T)[:2]/z - 0.5
cached_FRONT_records.pose_chain: local anchor metres -> coordinate_anchor -> world metres -> frame vehicle inverse pose -> inverse camera extrinsic -> camera axes. The existing calibration_text helper supplies the pinhole/extrinsic part for P0..P4.
cached_FRONT_records.caution: Do not use native model-unit xyz directly with these metre-valued matrices. meter_to_model=0.1; current road xyz are model units while coverage local_xyz are anchor metres.

surround_camera_followup.first_step: For patches with no FRONT witness, project the finite height-uncertain world patch through all supplied native camera calibrations and poses using indexed protobuf metadata, before decoding candidate camera images.
surround_camera_followup.decode_policy: Decode only the candidate camera/frame JPEGs likely to see the patch, then run measured support, occlusion and RGB quality checks. Preserve an unsearched flag until every required input is accounted for.
surround_camera_followup.native_dimensions_sampled: Cameras1/2/3 are 1920x1280; cameras4/5 are 1920x886 in all four inventory samples. A forced 480x320 side-camera image would require a different y scaling; use true dimensions and explicitly scaled intrinsics.
surround_camera_followup.calibration_caution: The current pinhole helper uses the first four of nine intrinsic parameters. A rigorous visibility-boundary claim must also cover the remaining distortion parameters and relevant camera pose/timing/rolling-shutter effects.

implemented_small_patch_ledger.scope: 331 supported query points from independently fixed raw137 audit regions across 199 cached FRONT frames. Full height-uncertainty or surround-camera search is not implemented by this diagnostic.
implemented_small_patch_ledger.result: 330 of331 queries already have actual FRONT RGB witnesses. One has no accepted witness and remains unknown, not never-visible.
